issue.title: Review-walk decision record predates the tracker tiers
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `decisions/review-walk-is-tiered.md` (strand of the `decisions` web)

Propose a new decision record that partly supersedes `review-walk-is-tiered` for the tracker tiers, leaving the existing record immutable: (1) PROJECTS is gated by `bob projects sync`'s `#hide` alone — no open-task occupancy count, no frontmatter `scheduled` gate, no `project_scheduled_invalid` lint; (2) REFERENCES walks between RETURNED and ROTTEN for every due in-scope `^ref` (never-confirmed Ready references included, on `reference_interval` when set else the Ready chain, in any lane, even with `pending_interval`/`next_interval: false`); (3) the walk order is NEW → PROJECTS → PENDING → NEXT → RETURNED → REFERENCES → ROTTEN with both tracker tiers on the commitment side of the ROTTEN boundary. Source: implemented from `plan:202610/tracker_hide_gate_and_references_tier.md` (bob-cli schema 7, ledger-tools 1.26.0, nav-hotkeys 1.71.0, `reference_interval: 7`). The record already predated the PROJECTS tier, so the new record should cover both tracker tiers together. Mark the old record with `metadata.status` plus `superseded_by` and a `[[...]]` back-link per the web's immutability rule.
